title: Bubble Shooter: Aim Once, Score by the Cascade
subtitle: A bubble-shooter teardown: aim angle folds into a column pick, 8-way pops raise density, and a ceiling drop every 10 shots makes pressure countable.
corePoints: Aim angle folds into a column pick: ±80° maps to 8 columns, landing known before release
8-way connectivity raises match odds, so beginners pop within the first shots
Ceiling drops by shot count, not a stopwatch: one row per 10 shots, pressure you can count
Floating drops pay 20 vs 10 per pop, teaching players to cut supports
Three colors keep the pace fast and a full clear genuinely reachable

breakdown.title: Rule Skeleton
bullets: 14 rows x 8 cols grid, 5 rows pre-filled at start, three bubble colors (blue/green/red)
Aim angle of +/-80 degrees maps directly to a target column: the bubble attaches below the lowest bubble in that column, or to the ceiling if the column is empty
8-way connected same-color clusters of 3+ pop for 10 points each; bubbles that lose their anchor to the top drop for 20 points each
Every 10 shots the ceiling pushes down one row; bottom-out or a full column ends the run, clearing the grid settles it as a win

breakdown.title: Behavior Loop
bullets: Read the board: grid gaps plus current/next bubble color decide the target column
Press and drag to show the aim guide, release to shoot (pointerDown aims / pointerUp fires)
Attach -> pop scoring -> floating cascade -> shot counter +1
At 10 shots the ceiling drops a row, pressing the grid toward the danger line; the result screen offers Restart or Menu

breakdown.title: Implementation Notes
bullets: core/bubble-shooter owns all rule data: bubbleGrid / currentBubble / nextBubble / score / comboCount
Rendering and pointer input come from the grid-shooter template of core/scene-renderer (PIXI); __OV.Games.BubbleShooter.Game is only a thin wrapper that registers the drawer
Matching uses 8-way flood fill; floating detection marks anchored bubbles with a BFS from the top row
The boot -> menu -> gameplay -> result state machine runs on the v2-kernel LogicGraph; button events and transition events share identical names

demo.note: Click Play to start. Press and drag inside the grid area to aim, release to shoot. Connect 3+ of a color to pop them; cut the supports to drop whole clusters. The ceiling drops one row every 10 shots — do not let the bubbles touch the bottom.
